$comment: Known axe-core violations on the audited public routes (Issue #393). One record per route and rule. A violation that is NOT listed here fails the release candidate; a record that no longer matches an observed violation fails too, so the ledger cannot be emptied to turn the gate green. See docs/verification/a11y/axe-route-report.md.
$history: Issue #718 (2026-11-01) fixed every recorded violation in the implementation, not in the ledger: the desktop nav markup (`editorial`), the home status list and the home capability links (`home`), and the portfolio facet chips (`portfolio`). The 10 records recorded on 2026-10-23 were therefore removed — the ledger is empty because the defects are gone, not because the gate was relaxed. An empty ledger still fails on the first new violation, and the manifest now declares `pass` for every audited route.
